gaps.sentence: Much to everyone’s ___ (APPOINT), the open-air concert was cancelled.
gaps.explanation: 'To somebody’s disappointment' — the feeling noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.

gaps.explanation: The subject is 'botany'; a specialist is a 'botanist'.

gaps.sentence: The shop is under new ___ (MANAGE) from Monday.
The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.
